name: Brando Benifei - § 8/1
title: REPORT on the institutional aspects of the Report on the future of European Competitiveness (Draghi Report)
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘including moving to qualified majority voting (QMV) and the ordinary legislative procedure, when it is needed, in key policy fields; notes that higher voting thresholds should be envisaged in some areas of vital importance;’
part_context: Welcomes the objective of accelerating the work of the EU and reiterates its call to progress towards greater efficiency in decision-making, <del>including moving to qualified majority voting (QMV) and the ordinary legislative procedure, when it is needed, in key policy fields; notes that higher voting thresholds should be envisaged in some areas of vital importance;</del> notes that in the past, solutions have been found that made decision-making processes more decisive; highlights, for example, the fact that the Treaty of Amsterdam introduced qualified majority voting, while also including the possibility of constructive abstention in certain policy fields;
